2022~2026Q1

2026-06-23

0. 데이터 불러오기

back <- read.csv("E:/26-1 수업/시계열/2차 피드백 발표/shop_back.csv")
colnames(back) <- c("quarter", "total", "china")
head(back)
##    quarter     total   china
## 1 2022.1/4 1,433,886 407,120
## 2 2022.2/4 1,477,039 513,251
## 3 2022.3/4 1,446,370 550,855
## 4 2022.4/4 1,588,061 636,131
## 5 2023.1/4 1,531,935 621,016
## 6 2023.2/4 1,651,862 778,613
back$total <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", back$total))
back$china <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", back$china))
str(back)
## 'data.frame':    17 obs. of  3 variables:
##  $ quarter: chr  "2022.1/4" "2022.2/4" "2022.3/4" "2022.4/4" ...
##  $ total  : num  1433886 1477039 1446370 1588061 1531935 ...
##  $ china  : num  407120 513251 550855 636131 621016 ...

1. 시계열 데이터로 변경

ts_back <- ts(
  back[, c("total", "china")],
  start = c(2022, 1),
  frequency = 4
)

ts_back
##           total   china
## 2022 Q1 1433886  407120
## 2022 Q2 1477039  513251
## 2022 Q3 1446370  550855
## 2022 Q4 1588061  636131
## 2023 Q1 1531935  621016
## 2023 Q2 1651862  778613
## 2023 Q3 1643306  821003
## 2023 Q4 1988739 1080799
## 2024 Q1 1862874 1021601
## 2024 Q2 2060723 1263717
## 2024 Q3 1943120 1179807
## 2024 Q4 2219544 1386101
## 2025 Q1 1955436 1220729
## 2025 Q2 2176245 1465968
## 2025 Q3 2122295 1414013
## 2025 Q4 2254192 1473614
## 2026 Q1 1978894 1227562
class(ts_back)
## [1] "mts"    "ts"     "matrix" "array"
plot(ts_back, main = "해외 온라인쇼핑 직접구매액")

ts.plot(ts_back, 
        col = c("blue", "red"),
        lty = c(1, 2),          
        main = "해외 온라인쇼핑 직접구매액")

legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("total", "china"), 
       col = c("blue", "red"), 
       lty = c(1, 2))

total <- ts_back[,1]
china <- ts_back[,2]

library(dplyr) 
library(forecast) 
library(ggplot2) 
library(lmtest)

total <- log(total)
china <- log(china)

2. 원시데이터 ACF, PACF, 단위근 검정

2-1. 차분 전 ACF/PACF

# total
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(total, main = 'acf(total) - 차분 전')
pacf(total, main = 'pacf(total) - 차분 전')

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
# china
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(china, main = 'acf(china) - 차분 전')
pacf(china, main = 'pacf(china) - 차분 전')

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

2-2. 단위근 검정 (ADF, KPSS)

library(tseries)
adf.test(total)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  total
## Dickey-Fuller = -0.44686, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.9773
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
adf.test(china)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  china
## Dickey-Fuller = 0.6215, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.99
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
kpss.test(total)
## 
##  KPSS Test for Level Stationarity
## 
## data:  total
## KPSS Level = 0.60817, Truncation lag parameter = 2, p-value = 0.02189
kpss.test(china)
## 
##  KPSS Test for Level Stationarity
## 
## data:  china
## KPSS Level = 0.62439, Truncation lag parameter = 2, p-value = 0.02042

3. 시계열 분해

3-1. 가법/승법 결정 (잔차 CV 비교)

# total
decomp_add <- decompose(total, type = "additive")
decomp_mul <- decompose(total, type = "multiplicative")
sd(decomp_add$random, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(total)
## [1] 0.001323613
sd(decomp_mul$random, na.rm= TRUE)
## [1] 0.0013113
# china
decomp_add <- decompose(china, type = "additive")
decomp_mul <- decompose(china, type = "multiplicative")
sd(decomp_add$random, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(china)
## [1] 0.001764066
sd(decomp_mul$random, na.rm = TRUE)
## [1] 0.001729359

3-2. 승법 분해 (decompose)

# total
de_total = decompose(total, type = c
                     ('multiplicative')) 
plot(de_total)
title(main = 'total_분해')

# china
de_china = decompose(china, type = c('multiplicative')) 
plot(de_china)
title(main = 'china_분해')

4. 차분 및 정상성 확인

4-1. total: 1차 차분 + 계절 차분

diff_season <- diff(diff(total), lag = 4)
adf.test(diff_season)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  diff_season
## Dickey-Fuller = -1.7712, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.6595
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
kpss.test(diff_season)
## 
##  KPSS Test for Level Stationarity
## 
## data:  diff_season
## KPSS Level = 0.2785, Truncation lag parameter = 2, p-value = 0.1
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(diff_season, main = "ACF(total) - 차분 후")
pacf(diff_season, main = "PACF(total) - 차분 후")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

4-2. china: 1차 차분 + 계절 차분

diff_season2 <- diff(diff(china), lag = 4)
diff_season3 <- diff(diff_season2)
adf.test(diff_season2)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  diff_season2
## Dickey-Fuller = -2.7917, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.2708
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
adf.test(diff_season3)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  diff_season3
## Dickey-Fuller = -1.6817, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.6936
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
kpss.test(diff_season3)
## 
##  KPSS Test for Level Stationarity
## 
## data:  diff_season3
## KPSS Level = 0.099425, Truncation lag parameter = 2, p-value = 0.1
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(diff_season2, main = "ACF2(china) - 차분 후")
pacf(diff_season2, main = "PACF2(china) - 차분 후")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

5. 모형 결정

5-1. 후보 모형 적합 및 모수 유의성 검정

total_1 <- arima(total, order=c(1,1,0), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,0), period=4))
coeftest(total_1)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##     Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)
## ar1 0.051563   0.286343  0.1801   0.8571
total_2 <- arima(total, order=c(0,1,0), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,0), period=4))
china_1 <- arima(china, order=c(0,1,0), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1), period=4))
coeftest(china_1)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##      Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)
## sma1  0.12908    0.45619  0.2829   0.7772
china_2 <- arima(china, order=c(0,1,0), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,0), period=4))

5-2. auto.arima 탐색

auto.arima(total)
## Series: total 
## ARIMA(0,1,0)(0,1,0)[4] 
## 
## sigma^2 = 0.002564:  log likelihood = 18.97
## AIC=-35.94   AICc=-35.54   BIC=-35.45
auto.arima(china)
## Series: china 
## ARIMA(0,1,0)(0,1,0)[4] 
## 
## sigma^2 = 0.005975:  log likelihood = 13.76
## AIC=-25.52   AICc=-25.12   BIC=-25.04

5-3. 최종 모형 선택

total_fit <- total_2
china_fit <- china_2

6. 잔차 진단

6-1. total 잔차 진단

ts.plot(resid(total_fit))
abline(h=0)

library(astsa)
acf2(resid(total_fit)) 

##      [,1] [,2]  [,3]  [,4]  [,5]  [,6] [,7]
## ACF     0  0.2 -0.23 -0.02 -0.15 -0.12 0.18
## PACF    0  0.2 -0.24 -0.05 -0.05 -0.17 0.25
qqnorm(resid(total_fit)) 
qqline(resid(total_fit))

6-2. china 잔차 진단

ts.plot(resid(china_fit))
abline(h=0)

acf2(resid(china_fit)) 

##      [,1] [,2]  [,3]  [,4] [,5]  [,6] [,7]
## ACF  0.18 0.12 -0.23 -0.09 0.13  0.06 0.19
## PACF 0.18 0.09 -0.28 -0.02 0.24 -0.07 0.11
qqnorm(resid(china_fit)) 
qqline(resid(china_fit))

6-3. Ljung-Box 검정

library(portes)
LjungBox(total_fit, lags = 8)
##  lags statistic df   p-value
##     8  5.042499  8 0.7530243
LjungBox(china_fit, lags = 8)
##  lags statistic df   p-value
##     8  7.630693  8 0.4703503

6-4. 이상치 확인

# total
res_total <- residuals(total_fit)
std_total <- (res_total - mean(res_total)) / sd(res_total)
out_total <- which(abs(std_total) > 2.5)
time(std_total)[out_total]
## numeric(0)
# china
res_china <- residuals(china_fit)
std_china <- (res_china- mean(res_china)) / sd(res_china)
out_china <- which(abs(std_china) > 2.5)
time(std_china)[out_china]
## [1] 2023.75

7. 예측

7-1. total, china 예측

library(forecast) 
p_total = forecast(total_fit, h=4)
pt_or <- p_total
pt_or$x     <- exp(p_total$x)
pt_or$mean  <- exp(p_total$mean) 
pt_or$lower <- exp(p_total$lower)
pt_or$upper <- exp(p_total$upper)
plot(pt_or) 

library(forecast)
(p_china = forecast(china_fit, h=4))
##         Point Forecast    Lo 80    Hi 80    Lo 95    Hi 95
## 2026 Q2       14.20361 14.10511 14.30211 14.05296 14.35426
## 2026 Q3       14.16752 14.02822 14.30683 13.95448 14.38057
## 2026 Q4       14.20881 14.03820 14.37942 13.94788 14.46974
## 2027 Q1       14.02612 13.82912 14.22313 13.72483 14.32742
pc_or1 <- p_china
pc_or1$x     <- exp(p_china$x)
pc_or1$mean  <- exp(p_china$mean) 
pc_or1$lower <- exp(p_china$lower)
pc_or1$upper <- exp(p_china$upper)
plot(pc_or1)

7-2. 적합값 비교 시각화

pred_total <- forecast(total_fit, h=4)
pred_china <- forecast(china_fit, h=4)
ft_or <- exp(fitted(total_fit))
fc_or <- exp(fitted(china_fit))
total_or <- exp(total)
china_or <- exp(china)

ylim_range <- range(total_or, china_or, ft_or, fc_or)

plot(total_or, main="total vs china 적합값 비교", ylab="", col="gray", ylim=ylim_range)
lines(china_or, col="gray", lty=2)
lines(ft_or, col="blue")
lines(fc_or, col="red")
legend("bottomright", legend=c("total 적합값","china 적합값"),
       col=c("blue","red"), lty=c(1,1))

8. 점유율 분석 (share = china / total)

8-1. 점유율 시계열 생성 및 변환 검토

back$share <- back$china / back$total
share <- ts(back$share, start = c(2022, 1), frequency = 4)
plot(share, main='중국의 해외직접구매 점유율')

BoxCox.lambda(share)
## [1] 1.567851
# share
decomp_add <- decompose(share, type = "additive")
decomp_mul <- decompose(share, type = "multiplicative")
sd(decomp_add$random, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(share)
## [1] 0.01086077
sd(decomp_mul$random, na.rm= TRUE)
## [1] 0.0123437

8-2. 차분 전 ACF/PACF 및 단위근 검정

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(share, main = "ACF - 차분 전 (share)")
pacf(share, main = "PACF - 차분 전 (share)")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
adf.test(share)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  share
## Dickey-Fuller = 0.90082, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.99
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
kpss.test(share)
## 
##  KPSS Test for Level Stationarity
## 
## data:  share
## KPSS Level = 0.63289, Truncation lag parameter = 2, p-value = 0.01965

8-3. 분해 (decompose)

de_share = decompose(share, type = c('additive')) 
plot(de_share)
title(main = 'share_분해')

8-4. 차분 및 정상성 확인

diff_share <- diff(diff(share), lag = 4)
adf.test(diff_share)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  diff_share
## Dickey-Fuller = -3.1255, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.1436
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
kpss.test(diff_share)
## 
##  KPSS Test for Level Stationarity
## 
## data:  diff_share
## KPSS Level = 0.34977, Truncation lag parameter = 2, p-value = 0.09881
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(diff_share, main = "ACF - 차분 후 (share)")
pacf(diff_share, main = "PACF - 차분 후 (share)")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

8-5. 후보 모형 적합 및 선택

share_1 <- arima(share, order = c(0,1,0), seasonal = list(order = c(0,1,0), period = 4))
share_2 <- arima(share, order = c(1,1,0), seasonal = list(order = c(0,1,0), period = 4))
share_3 <- arima(share, order=c(0,1,0), seasonal=list(order=c(1,1,0), period=4))

AIC(share_1, share_2,share_3)
##         df       AIC
## share_1  1 -57.93872
## share_2  2 -59.03938
## share_3  2 -56.16606
BIC(share_1, share_2, share_3)
##         df       BIC
## share_1  1 -57.45381
## share_2  2 -58.06957
## share_3  2 -55.19625
auto.arima(share)
## Series: share 
## ARIMA(0,2,0)(0,1,0)[4] 
## 
## sigma^2 = 0.0003859:  log likelihood = 24
## AIC=-46   AICc=-45.55   BIC=-45.6
coeftest(share_2)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##     Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)  
## ar1  0.51337    0.26264  1.9546  0.05062 .
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
share_fit <- share_2

8-6. 적합값 시각화

plot(share, main="share", ylab="", col="black")
lines(fitted(share_fit), col="green")
legend("topleft", legend=c("실제값","적합값"), col=c("black","green"), lty=1)

8-7. 잔차 진단

ts.plot(resid(share_fit))
abline(h = 0)

qqnorm(resid(share_fit))
qqline(resid(share_fit))

LjungBox(share_fit, lag=4)
##  lags statistic df   p-value
##     4  2.385106  3 0.4964132
acf2(resid(share_fit))

##       [,1] [,2]  [,3]  [,4] [,5]  [,6]  [,7]
## ACF  -0.12 0.15 -0.22 -0.13 0.39 -0.03  0.18
## PACF -0.12 0.14 -0.20 -0.21 0.46  0.04 -0.07
res_share <- residuals(share_fit)
std_share <- (res_share - mean(res_share)) / sd(res_share)
outlier_idx <- which(abs(std_share) > 2.5)
time(std_share)[outlier_idx]
## numeric(0)
